grapePatches.reason: Granatza is mapped by AGRIS to nationally registered Guarnaccia Bianca (106). Fanelli 2021 identifies several distinct homonymous Calabrian profiles; Saracena/ARSAC traits cannot be transferred to that canonical identity.

summary.en: A white variety documented by AGRIS in Sardegna as Granatza, with regular yields and relatively high grape acidity. The Guarnaccia name in Calabria covers genetically different material.
summary.zh: AGRIS 在 Sardegna 以 Granatza 记录的白品种，产量稳定、葡萄酸度较高；Calabria 的 Guarnaccia 名称涵盖不同基因型。

origin.en: AGRIS documents Granatza in old vineyards across Sardegna and identifies it with nationally registered Guarnaccia Bianca, code 106. The geographic origin is not settled by this synonymy.
origin.zh: AGRIS 记录 Granatza 广见于 Sardegna 老葡萄园，并对应国家注册 Guarnaccia Bianca、代码 106；此同义关系不能确定地理起源。

viticulture.en: AGRIS describes regular productivity and relatively high grape acidity. Calabrian Saracena/ARSAC morphology is not assigned to this authenticated Sardinian identity.
viticulture.zh: AGRIS 描述产量稳定、葡萄酸度较高；不将 Calabria Saracena／ARSAC 材料形态直接归入该经鉴定 Sardegna 身份。

winemaking.en: Traditionally associated with Sardinian dessert wines. AGRIS records historical confusion with Vernaccia di Oristano, although the genotypes differ.
winemaking.zh: 传统用于 Sardegna 甜点酒；AGRIS 记载历史上常与 Vernaccia di Oristano 混淆，但基因型不同。

confusions.en: Granatza matches the registered Guarnaccia Bianca identity according to AGRIS. Fanelli et al. (2021) found Guarnaccia Saracena/ARSAC distinct from the national-register and other database Guarnaccia profiles; do not apply this synonym to every Calabrian accession. Distinct from Vernaccia di Oristano.
confusions.zh: AGRIS 将 Granatza 对应注册 Guarnaccia Bianca；Fanelli 等（2021）发现 Guarnaccia Saracena／ARSAC 与国家注册及其他数据库的 Guarnaccia 材料不同，不可把该同义关系套用于所有 Calabria 材料。亦不同于 Vernaccia di Oristano。

context.en: Name documented in Oliena (Nuoro) by AGRIS; retain the Sardinian locality.
context.zh: AGRIS 记录于 Oliena（Nuoro）的名称，须保留 Sardegna 地点语境。

grapePatches.reason: Reported VIVC pedigree concerns a profile shown in 2021 to differ from ARSAC Greco Nero; state both findings without inventing a unified pedigree.

summary.en: A Calabrian red used in regional blends, including the permitted complement of Cirò Classico DOCG. Several genetically distinct accessions have carried the name Greco Nero.
summary.zh: Calabria 红葡萄，用于地方混酿，包括 Cirò Classico DOCG 允许的补充组分；Greco Nero 名下存在多个不同基因型。

geneticsNote.en: Lacombe et al. report Terrano × Garnacha for the Vassal Greco Nero accession, reflected in VIVC. Fanelli et al. (2021) found the VIVC profile distinct from ARSAC Greco Nero; that pedigree cannot be assigned unconditionally to the Calabrian material used here.
geneticsNote.zh: Lacombe 等对 Vassal Greco Nero 材料报告 Terrano × Garnacha，VIVC 亦收录；但 Fanelli 等（2021）发现 VIVC 与 ARSAC Greco Nero 基因型不同，不能无条件将该亲缘归给本档案的 Calabria 材料。

confusions.en: ARSAC-authenticated Greco Nero is distinct from Magliocco Dolce and Greco Bianco. Its profile also differed from VIVC Greco Nero in the 2021 study; identity and pedigree claims require the accession to be specified.
confusions.zh: 经 ARSAC 鉴定的 Greco Nero 不同于 Magliocco Dolce、Greco Bianco；2021 研究亦发现其不同于 VIVC Greco Nero，身份与亲缘判断须注明具体材料。

grapePatches.reason: Replace generic introduction and restore molecularly confirmed synonyms from the same primary study.

summary.en: A late-ripening Cosenza red used for concentrated varietal wines and blends. Thick skins and substantial phenolic potential make extraction and maturation important; authenticated Arvino and Lagrima Nera are synonyms.
summary.zh: Cosenza 晚熟红葡萄，可酿浓郁单品种及混酿；厚皮及较高酚类潜力使萃取与熟化重要，经鉴定 Arvino、Lagrima Nera 为同义名。

confusions.en: Authenticated Magliocco Dolce is distinct from Magliocco Canino, Greco Nero, Notardomenico and Brettio Nero. Arvino and Lagrima Nera match its profile in Fanelli et al. (2021).
confusions.zh: 经鉴定 Magliocco Dolce 不同于 Magliocco Canino、Greco Nero、Notardomenico、Brettio Nero；Fanelli 等（2021）确认 Arvino、Lagrima Nera 与其同型。

context.en: Calabrian accession synonym confirmed by SSR in Fanelli et al. (2021).
context.zh: Fanelli 等（2021）以 SSR 确认的 Calabria 材料同义名。

context.en: Calabrian accession synonym confirmed by SSR in Fanelli et al. (2021).
context.zh: Fanelli 等（2021）以 SSR 确认的 Calabria 材料同义名。

body.en: The Saracena/ARSAC Guarnaccia material was genetically distinct from the national-register Guarnaccia Bianca profile in Fanelli et al. (2021); the Sardinian Granatza synonym is therefore not transferred automatically.
body.zh: Fanelli 等（2021）发现 Saracena／ARSAC Guarnaccia 与国家注册 Guarnaccia Bianca 不同；因此不自动套用 Sardegna Granatza 同义关系。
